preferences.title: Notification preferences
preferences.description: Choose which notifications reach you in the bell and which of them are also emailed to you.
preferences.emailOff: Email is not set up on this deployment, so no notification emails are sent. The bell still works and your email choices are kept.
preferences.emailNeedsBell: A notification arrives by email only when it also arrives in the bell, so the email switch of a row is off while its bell switch is off.
preferences.saveFailedNetwork: Saving the preferences failed. Check your connection and try again.

ROLE_ASSIGNED.label: You are given a role
ROLE_ASSIGNED.description: Someone gives you a DACI role on an ADR.

ROLE_REMOVED.label: Your role is taken away
ROLE_REMOVED.description: Someone takes your DACI role on an ADR away.

STATUS_CHANGED.label: An ADR changes status
STATUS_CHANGED.description: An ADR you take part in moves to another status. Everyone on it hears about this, the Informed included.

DISCUSSION_POSTED.label: Something is posted
DISCUSSION_POSTED.description: A comment, question, issue or escalation is posted on an ADR you take part in. The Driver and the Approver hear about every entry, Contributors only about comments and questions.

DISCUSSION_SETTLED.label: Your entry is settled
DISCUSSION_SETTLED.description: Someone answers your question or resolves your issue or escalation.

ADR_EXPIRED.label: An ADR expires
ADR_EXPIRED.description: The expiry date of an ADR you take part in has passed.

ADR_SUPERSEDED.label: An ADR is superseded
ADR_SUPERSEDED.description: A successor takes over an ADR you take part in.

SUCCESSOR_LINKED.label: A successor is proposed
SUCCESSOR_LINKED.description: Someone proposes a successor for an ADR you drive or approve.

SUCCESSOR_UNLINKED.label: A successor is detached
SUCCESSOR_UNLINKED.description: Someone detaches the successor of an ADR you drive or approve.

EXPIRY_REMINDER.label: An expiry is coming up
EXPIRY_REMINDER.description: The system reminds you that an ADR you drive or approve is about to expire.

EXPIRY_CHANGED.label: The expiry date of a decision in force changes
EXPIRY_CHANGED.description: Someone changes or removes the expiry date of an ADR in force that you take part in. Only the Approver or an administrator may.

SUCCESSOR_ACCEPTED.label: A successor is accepted
SUCCESSOR_ACCEPTED.description: The Approver of a decision in force accepts the successor you drive or approve, which it needs to take that decision's place.
